judge.rationale: The candidate implemented the wrong wire protocol names (`list_sessions` and `session_list` with `sessions` instead of `list_conversations` and `conversation_list` with `conversations`, and wrong TypeScript interface names). It completely omitted the opt-in configuration flag `transport.history: {enabled: boolean}` (leaving the feature unconditionally enabled) and the `ErrorCodes.UNSUPPORTED` error code. Furthermore, it explicitly violated a core requirement and acceptance criterion by returning an empty list (`sessions: []`) when a store lacks `listFor` instead of returning an `UNSUPPORTED` error frame. Validation also missed the `1–200` range constraint on `limit` (allowing `0` and `> 200`), logged the raw store error message (which the spec and reference avoid to prevent leaking driver credentials), and skipped updating `specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md`, `example/full-config.ts`, and `docs/getting-started.md`.
